data.name: Form_Config_Description
data.value: Adjust each screen. Changes are saved for the next app launch.

data.name: Validation_DuplicatePort_Message
data.value: Screen 2 must use a different port than Screen 1.

data.name: Tab_TouchPreserveCursor_Help
data.value: If enabled, the pointer will return to its original position after a tap or after finishing a gesture. If disabled, the pointer will stay where you touched.

data.name: Tab_Help_Port
data.value: Set the local port you will use to open your remote monitor from a web browser.

data.name: Tab_Help_Transmission
data.value: For PCs with a GPU or good performance, WebRTC is the best option. For less powerful PCs, Image over web is recommended.

data.name: Tab_Help_Placement
data.value: This placement is applied when the monitors start. You can rearrange them later in Windows display settings.

data.name: Tab_Help_CaptureInterval
data.value: Time between image updates. For smoother motion use less than 10 ms; for e-ink displays we recommend more than 100 ms.

data.name: Tab_Help_ScreenSecurity
data.value: This option requires entering the generated access code before the screen can be viewed.

data.name: Tab_Help_TouchMode
data.value: Tap only: clicks without moving cursor, no drag/scroll. Gestures: enables drag/scroll but cursor moves to touch location.

data.name: Tab_Help_TouchGestures
data.value: Hold time for touch gestures. Lower values react faster; higher values reduce accidental drags/scroll.

data.name: Tab_Help_MaxViewers
data.value: This is the maximum number of devices allowed to watch your screen stream. If it is 0, the limit is disabled.

data.name: About_Subtitle
data.value: Your virtual desktop, available on any device connected to the same local network.

data.name: About_Message
data.value: Virtual Web Display was created to stream a virtual desktop to any other device connected to the same local network in a simple, direct way.

data.name: About_Footer
data.value: Thank you for choosing Virtual Web Display.

data.name: Tray_Balloon_ConfigSaved_Message
